description.fun: Nincada can spend up to ten years underground, almost blind, feeling its way with its antennae and sucking moisture and nutrients from tree roots with its claws. It hates sunlight. Its evolution is unique: it's the only Pokémon that turns into two at once, since its shed shell can come to life as Shedinja. Its name blends ninja and cicada.
description.guide: A Bug- and Ground-type Pokémon based on a cicada nymph that lives underground, nearly blind, feeding on tree roots. It evolves into Ninjask at level 20, and Shedinja appears too if there is room in the party and, from Generation 4 on, a regular Poké Ball in the Bag.
description.tagline: A buried cicada nymph that can evolve into two Pokémon at once

branches.text: Nincada always becomes Ninjask at level 20. If there's an empty party slot at that moment, a Shedinja appears as well, so one Nincada becomes two Pokémon; from Generation 4 on, this also uses up a regular Poké Ball from the Bag (Generation 3 needs no ball). It's the only Pokémon that evolves into two at once.

description.fun: Ninjask moves so fast that it was long believed to be invisible, and it's said it can dodge any attack. It's demanding too: if it isn't trained properly it refuses to obey and cries loudly, a noise that gives anyone a headache, so it's said to test its Trainer's skill. Its English name blends ninja and mask, and the ninja theme runs through the whole family.
description.guide: A Bug- and Flying-type Pokémon based on an adult cicada, the evolution of Nincada. It is extremely fast and disobeys Trainers who haven't trained it properly. It gathers around tree sap to feed.
description.tagline: A cicada so fast it was long thought to be invisible

description.fun: Shedinja is Nincada's cast-off shell come to life: when Nincada evolves into Ninjask, the empty husk can move into an empty Poké Ball. It's completely hollow, doesn't breathe and floats without beating its wings, and it's said that looking into the hole in its back will steal your spirit. Its name mixes 'shed' with 'ninja', echoing the ninja trick of escaping by leaving a decoy behind.
description.guide: A Bug- and Ghost-type Pokémon resembling a cicada's shed shell with a halo above it. It appears alongside Ninjask when Nincada evolves, if there is space in the party and, from Generation 4 on, a regular Poké Ball in the Bag. It is hollow, with no organs, and is known for having just 1 HP.
description.tagline: A cicada's empty shell that came to life wearing a halo

transitions.how: An empty party slot and a spare Poké Ball
